$description: Qeetrix design tokens — the dark colour scheme at default density, resolved. Generated by @qeetrix/tokens from qeetrix.resolver.json; do not edit.

accent.$description: The Ember bar that marks the current item, and the intent line on top of a dialog.

highlight.$description: Starred, rated or pinned marks — rating stars.

selection.$description: The text-selection highlight: the brand colour at 20%.

on-bold.$description: Text on the danger, success and info bold fills.

on-warning.$description: Text on bg.warning.bold — amber carries dark text.

subtlest.$description: Placeholders and tertiary text — still AA.

marker-size.$description: Timeline event markers: a 28px square around a 16px icon (size.icon.sm). In px like the icon sizes, so the marker and its icon keep their proportions when the root font size changes.

offset.$description: Distance between a tour card and its target.

spotlight-padding.$description: Space the spotlight leaves around its target.

body.$description: A11y (0), Qeet Sans's most legible letter style. Authored as a value, not an alias: Terrazzo leaves an alias to a 0 unresolved.

standard.$description: Something that stays on screen changes: a size, a position, a colour.

disabled.$description: For disabled content that has no disabled colour of its own — an image, a whole illustration.

650.$description: Used by the dark scheme only, for bg.brand.bold-hover (QTRX-187): between 600 and 700, a hover step darker than 600 that keeps 3:1 against every dark surface, overlay included (3.31:1), and white text at 4.5:1 (5.04:1). 700, the light scheme's hover, is 2.93:1 on the dark overlay.

control.$description: Buttons, fields, selects: every control. Fields round only their top corners.

full.$description: People and choices that must read round: avatars, radios, presence dots.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers and other floating surfaces.

sm.$description: Small marks that stay square: a checkbox, a switch track, a keyboard key.

2xs.$description: Marks inside 16–20px chips: Badge, filter tags.

row.$description: Table and list row height per density.

min.$description: The smallest pointer target any control may have (WCAG 2.2, 2.5.8 Target Size, Minimum).

gap.$description: Space between form fields per density.

caps.$description: Small capitals that label a group: navigation sections, table column groups, panel sections. The component sets text-transform: uppercase, which isn't a token. Tracked +6% (0.66px at 11px) so the capitals don't crowd.

popover.$description: Above modals, so a popover opened from a dialog shows.
